description: OpenConnector source registrations for Shillinq. Registered via ConfigurationService::importFromApp() on install. Per ADR-019, every external system integration (RvO submissions) rides an openconnector source — no app-local HTTP clients.

sources.name: RvO WBSO Submissions
sources.description: OpenConnector source for submitting WBSO mededeling, kwartaalrapportage, and jaarrapport to RvO (Rijksdienst voor Ondernemend Nederland) per REQ-WBSO-005. Shillinq references this source id from docudesk template output-channel declarations — no lib/Service/RvoSubmissieClient.php.

auth.description: RvO eHerkenning OAuth2 — credentials managed in OpenConnector, not in Shillinq.

mededeling.description: Submit quarterly mededeling of realised S&O hours per REQ-WBSO-003.

auditTrail.description: Every RvO submission event and RvO response is recorded in the OR audit-trail-immutable per ADR-022.
